jobs.description:
3M has a long-standing reputation as a company committed to innovation. We provide the freedom to explore and encourage curiosity and creativity. We gain new insight from diverse thinking, and take risks on new ideas. Here, you can apply your talent in bold ways that matter.

Job Description:

At 3M CHK, we are expanding our AI enablement capabilities within the GBS Analytics & Insights team to accelerate and scale AI adoption across the enterprise. We are seeking an AI Business Consultant to identify high-value opportunities, shape business use cases, define measurable outcomes, and support the adoption of AI solutions across business functions, R&D for Commercial Excellence and Innovation Excellence.
This is a highly collaborative role at the intersection of business, analytics, AI, IT and Legal. You will work with cross-functional stakeholders and technical partners to turn ideas into practical, scalable solutions that deliver measurable business impact.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will:
- Identify and collect business challenges and opportunities where AI can create measurable value
- Translate ambiguous business needs into clear AI use cases, business requirements, and success metrics
- Build business cases and define KPIs, ROI, and value realization plans
- Partner with technical teams to shape solution concepts and align business requirements with technical feasibility
- Support solution design discussions involving generative AI, RAG, multi-agent workflows, predictive models, and integration with enterprise systems
- Contribute to rapid prototyping and proof-of-concept efforts to validate feasibility and business value
- Drive stakeholder alignment across business teams and partner functions
- Help measure impact and support scaling of successful AI solutions across the enterprise

What We’re Looking For

- Bachelor’s degree or above in Business Analytics, Data Science / Artificial Intelligence, Management Science / Statistics, Computer Science or a related field
- 3+ years of experience in analytics, digital transformation, consulting, AI product management, or a similar business-facing role
- Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to turn ambiguity into structured opportunities
- Good understanding of AI, analytics, or digital solutions in a business environment
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across business and technical teams
- A collaborative, execution-oriented mindset with the ability to work in a matrixed organization

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting AI, automation, advanced analytics, or digital transformation programs
- Familiarity with generative AI, RAG, predictive analytics, or workflow automation
- Experience in commercial, innovation or other enterprise functions
- Exposure to prototyping, pilots, or proof-of-concept initiatives
- Familiarity with enterprise data platforms, applications is a plus

Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to help shape how AI creates measurable value across the enterprise. You will work across a diverse set of functions and partner with both business and technical teams to turn ideas into scalable solutions with real impact.

If you are excited by solving business problems, shaping AI use cases, and helping organizations adopt AI in practical ways, we would like to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Job Title
Director, Strategy & Business Development – Consumer Business

Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World
Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers.

This position provides an opportunity to transition from other private, public, government or military experience to a 3M career.

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role
3M’s Consumer Business Group (CBG) is the ~$5 billion business behind Post-it®, Scotch®, Command™, Scotch-Brite®, Filtrete™, Meguiar’s®, Nexcare™ and ACE™ — brands that hold the #1 or a leading share position in the large majority of the categories where they compete, backed by 3M’s material-science innovation engine and margins at the top of the consumer peer set. CBG is in the middle of a deliberate transformation into a top-tier consumer packaged goods organization: one global brand-portfolio operating model executed across five area markets, and three growth priorities — portfolio reinvention, demand generation, and distribution & channel.

The Strategy & Business Development team reports to the Consumer Group President, and it sits where the $5 billion choices get made. This Director role reports to the Vice President, Strategy & Business Development, and is built for someone who has led hypothesis-driven strategy or transformation work at a top-tier consulting firm or inside a leading CPG company and now wants to own the answer and the outcome, not just the recommendation. You will own two to three CBG-priority initiatives at a time, from blank page to embedded change, with the mandate and air cover to land them, and you will shape the materials that go to the Group President, CEO, and Board.

As a Director, Strategy & Business Development – Consumer Business , you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:
- Shaping CBG’s multi-year strategic roadmap — building the three-year plan and the category, channel, and area strategies beneath it (where to play, how to win, what to stop), with explicit revenue, margin, and investment implications.
- Leading two to three high-priority transformation initiatives end to end — from problem framing and hypothesis-driven analysis through execution, adoption, and measured P&L impact — across operating-model redesign, portfolio simplification, revenue growth management, ecommerce and retail media, and international go-to-market.
- Evaluating and building business development opportunities — screening acquisitions, licensing, divestitures, and strategic partnerships against CBG’s strategic filters, and building the business cases that inform investment decisions.
- Running CBG’s strategic planning and performance cadence — annual operating planning, KPI definition, initiative tracking, and long-range planning with Finance — so it works as a decision engine rather than a reporting exercise.
- Preparing executive-ready materials and decision support for the CBG leadership team, Group President, CEO, and Board forums, while leading cross-functional project teams and external advisors to deliver.

What you get in return: a direction-setting seat in a $5 billion consumer business at a pivotal moment in its transformation; a focused set of priority initiatives with the mandate to land them; ongoing exposure to the CBG leadership team, Group President, and 3M enterprise leadership; and a recognized launch pad, because the strategy team is a talent pool for broader leadership roles across CBG and 3M.

Your Skills and Expertise
To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree or higher (completed and verified prior to start)
- Seven (7) years of experience in consumer-packaged goods strategy, transformation, commercial, or marketing roles and/or in strategy consulting serving consumer and retail clients, in a private, public, government or military environment
- Five (5) years of experience leading strategy or transformation projects end to end, from problem framing and hypothesis-driven analysis through executive alignment and implementation
- Five (5) years of experience building P&L, business-case, and scenario models and working with consumer, retail, pricing, promotion, or syndicated data
- Five (5) years of experience influencing and partnering across a matrixed organization, including functions such as Finance, Marketing, Commercial, Supply Chain, R&D, or HR

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

- MBA or equivalent graduate degree from an accredited institution
- Experience at a top-tier strategy consulting firm serving the consumer sector, a leading CPG brand owner, or a leading retailer — ideally more than one of these
- Hands-on experience in one or more of CBG’s growth levers: portfolio and lifecycle management, revenue growth management, ecommerce and retail media, route-to-market, brand strategy, or digital demand generation
- Corporate development experience (deal screening, valuation, due diligence, integration, separation, or strategic partnerships) and/or experience leading a transformation PMO or operating-model change
- International or multi-market experience, executive-level communication and facilitation skills, and fluency with AI-enabled analysis and productivity tools

Job Description: Finance Manager – Consumer Business Group Japan
Join our team as a Finance Manager for the Consumer Business Group, where you will serve as a trusted business partner to business leaders. You will provide critical financial insights, challenge assumptions, and support initiatives that drive performance, optimize resource allocation, and ensure financial objectives are achieved in alignment with the organization’s strategic goals.

Business Partnership & Financial Insights
- Collaborate with key stakeholders across functions to understand business drivers and deliver financial insights that support strategic and operational decision-making.
- Serve as a proactive partner to Sales and Marketing teams, ensuring high-quality financial input into commercial plans and initiatives.

Forecasting & Performance Management
- Lead weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual sales forecasting routines, ensuring high accuracy and robust visibility into risks and opportunities.
- Continuously enhance forecasting models, assumptions, and analytical processes to improve predictability and support business agility.

Revenue Growth Management (RGM)
- Drive financial leadership in customer trading term optimization (e.g., CIP, MDF, chargeback structures) to improve profitability and return on investment.
- Support the development and evaluation of pricing strategies, including price architecture, pack-price design, and price realization tracking.
- Provide insights to improve portfolio mix, identifying opportunities to shift toward higher-margin categories, channels, or customers.
- Analyse financial implications of distribution placement, channel expansion, and assortment decisions to maximize revenue and margin.
- Partner with commercial teams to evaluate promotional plans and ensure efficient trade spend deployment.

Financial Reporting & Variance Analysis
- Deliver timely and accurate monthly management reports, forecasts, and variance analyses, highlighting key performance drivers and recommended actions.
- Maintain KPI dashboards and performance scorecards to monitor commercial and financial health.

Budgeting, Expense Tracking & Cost Management
- Support and coordinate the annual budgeting and periodic reforecasting processes across departments, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.
- Track and review operating expenses, ensuring spending discipline and timely identification of deviations versus plan.

Investment Analysis & Decision Support
- Conduct financial analysis for business cases, pricing decisions, investment proposals, and cost-saving initiatives.
- Perform ROI assessments, scenario modelling, and sensitivity analyses to support investment prioritization and resource allocation.

Risk & Opportunity Management
- Identify financial risks and opportunities and provide actionable recommendations to mitigate or capitalize on them.
- Support cross-functional teams in developing corrective action plans and growth strategies.

Process Improvement & Capability Building
- Partner with operational teams to strengthen financial processes, improve data accuracy, and promote continuous improvement.
- Enhance financial literacy across the organization through training, tools, and ongoing support.

Governance & Compliance

- Provide Finance Compliance training/guidance to non-Finance stakeholders

- Working language in both Japanese and English
- Strong financial modelling, analytical, and presentation skills.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and build relationships at all levels.

- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field;
- 10+ years of finance experience, ideally in CPG/FMCG or a commercial environment.
- Strong skills in forecasting, budgeting, expense tracking, and variance analysis.
- Proven ability to support Sales/Marketing teams and influence cross-functional decisions.
- Solid analytical and financial modelling capabilities; advanced Excel skills.
- Strong communication skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
- Experience with financial systems (e.g., SAP, Power BI) is a plus.
- Detail-oriented, proactive

The Operations Program Manager (OPM) serves as 3M's primary operations leader at contract manufacturing partners in China, responsible for product launch readiness, factory execution, capacity planning, and operational risk management. The OPM drives cross-functional alignment between 3M and contract manufacturers to ensure products are launched on time, achieve operational targets, and maintain uninterrupted supply to customers.
This role acts as the central point of coordination across Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Procurement, Planning, and Contract Manufacturing partners to deliver successful product introductions and sustain operational excellence throughout the product lifecycle.

Core Responsibilities
Manufacturing Operations Management
- Lead operational readiness activities for new product introductions (NPI), product transfers, and capacity expansion programs at contract manufacturing sites.
- Drive factory readiness reviews covering manpower, materials, manufacturing processes, equipment, and production capacity prior to qualification and mass production.
- Partner with Manufacturing Engineering and Quality teams to ensure successful build events, pilot runs, qualification activities, and production ramp-up.
- Identify operational risks that may impact launch schedules and drive mitigation plans to ensure on-time product introduction.
- Lead production ramp planning and execution to achieve targeted output, yield, and customer availability requirements.

Contract Manufacturing Operations
- Own daily operational engagement with contract manufacturers to ensure alignment across production schedules, material availability, equipment readiness, and manufacturing capacity.
- Monitor production performance against demand forecasts, shipment commitments, and operational targets.
- Drive rapid resolution of operational issues impacting delivery, production output, or supply continuity.
- Coordinate factory execution activities and provide operational status updates to regional and global stakeholders.
- Establish operating rhythms and performance reviews with contract manufacturing partners.

Capacity Planning & Supply Readiness
- Develop and maintain capacity plans to support business forecasts and long-term growth requirements.
- Validate supplier production capabilities, resource readiness, and expansion plans to ensure sufficient manufacturing capacity.
- Identify capacity constraints and lead mitigation activities across suppliers and internal stakeholders.
- Partner with Supply Planning and Operations teams to align production loading, inventory strategies, and customer demand requirements.
- Manage operational assumptions used in forecast planning and capacity modeling.

Cross-Functional Program Leadership
- Lead cross-functional operational workstreams involving Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Procurement, Planning, and Commercial teams.
- Drive program execution across timelines, milestones, deliverables, and stakeholder alignment.
- Facilitate decision-making and issue resolution among internal organizations and contract manufacturing partners.

Risk Management & Escalation
- Serve as the primary operations point of contact for contract manufacturing partners.

- Serve as the primary operational point of contact for contract manufacturing partners.
